integrity: A complete theoretical proof and independently executable exact-rational finite checks are supplied. Only self-review is reported; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Characterization concerns only nonnegative-determinant two-state stochastic transitions.
The general unrestricted two-state problem over larger alphabets is not classified.
Finite rational checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
Historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
Rational parameter bit-size bound is for the explicit constructed witnesses, not an optimal lower bound.
title: Optimal words of orientation-preserving two-state probabilistic automata
